detailLevelHelp.compact: Same data universe, with temporal buckets up to 30 days for prices and up to 84 days for the slowest indicators.

detailLevelHelp.full: Same data universe, with temporal buckets up to 7 days for prices and up to 14 days for the slowest indicators.
